description: Browse, save, restore, export, and import ChiSurf projects using the MMFDB database with version control.

rpc_methods.name: project_browser.list
rpc_methods.description: List the readable project versions, grouped by project.

rpc_methods.name: project_browser.save
rpc_methods.description: Save the current session as a new version of a project.

rpc_methods.name: project_browser.restore
rpc_methods.description: Restore the exact session snapshot stored with a project version.

rpc_methods.name: project_browser.export_csp
rpc_methods.description: Export a project version as a .pto file.

rpc_methods.name: project_browser.import_preview
rpc_methods.description: Check a project file against the database before importing it.

rpc_methods.name: project_browser.import_csp
rpc_methods.description: Import a project file as new project versions.

rpc_methods.name: project_browser.create_branch
rpc_methods.description: Start a branch from a project version.

rpc_methods.name: project_browser.list_branches
rpc_methods.description: List the branches of the readable project versions.

rpc_methods.name: project_browser.version_graph
rpc_methods.description: Return the version history of a project as a graph.

rpc_methods.name: project_browser.artifacts
rpc_methods.description: List the artifacts stored with a project version.

rpc_methods.name: project_browser.parameters
rpc_methods.description: List the parameters stored with a project version.
